package.name: cyton_accuracy_check
package.description: Single combined program (run_accuracy_check) that both commands the arm via MoveIt and captures each pose's NDI measurement in one synchronized loop -- same shape as the original tests/test_five_pose_ndi_capture.cpp (move, settle, capture, repeat, no manual cross-terminal coordination), but with MoveIt doing the moving instead of raw Dynamixel ticks. Built after cyton_pose_commander + cyton_ndi_capture's separate two-terminal workflow was found to be vulnerable to a real timing race (a capture landing before the move had actually finished) -- see CLAUDE.md's kinematic-calibration section.
